author: polynoamial
text: Everyone at @OpenAI is united. This is not a civil war. Unless Sam and Greg are brought back, there will be no OpenAI left to govern.

quoted.text: About 650 / 770 signed at this moment. As people start waking up, more will come. All the efforts started after 1:30 AM, 500+ within two hours and all of this after 2 crazy days with very little sleep.

author: polynoamial
text: My teammates and I at @OpenAI are hiring ML engineers for research on LLM multi-step reasoning! We recently hit a SOTA 78% on MATH: https://t.co/Uyo1E9mWJc. Our new plans are even more ambitious. If you want to pursue this with us send a resume/linkedin to michelle.kim@openai.com https://t.co/yVpfJcBULD

quoted.text: I’m thrilled to share that I've joined @OpenAI! 🚀 For years I’ve researched AI self-play and reasoning in games like Poker and Diplomacy. I’ll now investigate how to make these methods truly general. If successful, we may one day see LLMs that are 1,000x better than GPT-4 🌌 1/

author: polynoamial
text: Improved capabilities are always risky but if this research succeeds it could be valuable for safety research as well. Imagine being able to spend $1 million on inference to see what a more capable future model might look like. It would give us a warning that we otherwise lack 5/

author: polynoamial
text: All those prior methods are specific to the game. But if we can discover a general version, the benefits could be huge. Yes, inference may be 1,000x slower and more costly, but what inference cost would we pay for a new cancer drug? Or for a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis? 4/

author: polynoamial
text: In 2016, AlphaGo beat Lee Sedol in a milestone for AI. But key to that was the AI's ability to "ponder" for ~1 minute before each move. How much did that improve it? For AlphaGoZero, it's the equivalent of scaling pretraining by ~100,000x (~5200 Elo with search, ~3000 without) 2/ https://t.co/1MuHWmiurn

author: polynoamial
text: I’m thrilled to share that I've joined @OpenAI! 🚀 For years I’ve researched AI self-play and reasoning in games like Poker and Diplomacy. I’ll now investigate how to make these methods truly general. If successful, we may one day see LLMs that are 1,000x better than GPT-4 🌌 1/

author: polynoamial
text: Not easy, but if we can figure out how to extend this to LLMs the impact would be huge. Imagine having access to models that take 5 minutes to ponder each response but the output is as good as a model that's 1,000x larger and trained for 1,000x longer than GPT-4

quoted.text: I keep revisiting this great paper from @andy_l_jones: “Scaling scaling laws with board games”. It shows how training compute and inference compute of MCTS can be traded off against each other. 10x more MCTS steps is almost the same as training 10x more. https://t.co/XiiaDtQewN https://t.co/XriLZVt3AY

author: polynoamial
text:
I signed this because I am concerned about the consequences of an arms race in AI. Preventing that requires global coordination.

"Mitigating the risk of extinction from AI should be a global priority alongside other societal-scale risks such as pandemics and nuclear war."
